notes: All observations use real SplitEdge component and point clicks and public Rhino APIs/commands in an owned private Xvfb session. User desktops and existing Rhino sessions were not used.
Portable requests substitute the exact source recipe for the shared box artifact. The final response is compacted as JSON without numerical normalization or array reordering.

The preliminary 29-case diagnostic used an incorrect ellipse target x=2. For center x=4 and radius_x=3 the opposite-seam target is analytically x=1; this was corrected before the independent final 37-case run. The preliminary response is not retained as a replay fixture.

Every point frame records the public World-to-Screen transform, world aim, WorldToClient result, integer click, viewport size and camera pose at the actual point prompt. Matrix projection is cross-checked against WorldToClient within 1e-7 pixels.

Nine geometry families each test one-shot Mid, persistent Mid-only and persistent Point+Mid. Eight circle/ellipse cases cover isolated hover, mixed-mode hover and target capture; two further cases test competing objects and polyline segments.

Native queries use the recorded projection, actual click and 12-pixel capture radius. Twenty-six native captured points drive complete ordered geometry, attributes, selection and history replay at absolute 1e-9 and relative 1e-10. Output positions are never used as snap input.

Eleven mixed-mode misses compare admission only, not unsnapped screen-to-edge geometry. Ten of these controls split and have actual Undo/Redo. The rational-mixed control fails to split and has no history replay; its failure is retained, not relabeled as a geometry match.

With all five modes enabled, the circle/ellipse target is both Mid and Quad. Geometry alone cannot establish Rhino's displayed snap label; native replay accepts either label only for these two coincident-target cases.

Midpoint location and hover selection are separate operations. Native curved hover is bounded numerical search, not a certified global closest-point solver or universal Rhino camera, priority or performance parity.
